instruction: A clean studio photograph, full shot at eye-level, depicts an indoor ballet studio with a wooden barre. On the left, the dark-haired girl in a pink leotard (R2) stands with her back to the camera, her arms raised in a curved ballet pose. On the right, the blonde girl in a pink leotard (R1) stands facing forward, her arms extended gracefully to her sides. They pose close together in front of the barre under bright, soft studio lighting, set against a minimalist white wall with a reflective floor.
